thread:
nina: Heads-up — APAC (sg1) L40s show vendor_allocated=120, our telemetry active=96. Did someone request a warm pool? :mag:

raj: I submitted a request yesterday for a customer dry-run but I toggled the tag to `warm-demo`. I thought warm-demo was soft.

procurement-bot: PO-10122 created 2026-03-20 by raj. Tags: ["warm-demo"]. Vendor policy: tag `warm-demo` -> auto-confirm allocation if invoice uploaded by known contact.

lucy: Oof. Finance just ran overnight invoice sync earlier which may have pushed allocations through if invoice was present. finance-bot, any auto-payments?

finance-bot: No payment processed for PO-10122. Invoice draft present; auto-pay blocked by billing threshold rule because project=trial.

nina: That matches why we see allocated > active but no charge. ops-oncall, any hardware maintenance in sg1?

ops-oncall: Short kernel security backports on rack-3 and rack-4 started 02:15 SGT, expected 30-45m. Affected GPUs: 24. That explains ~24 slot difference.

raj: I'll reach out to vendor to revert allocation to provisional. Planning note: we need warm slots for Tue demo but don't want them billed until day-of.

procurement-bot: Suggested action: update PO status to `provisional` and remove `warm-demo` tag. Vendor requires PO status change to trigger de-allocation.

nina: Quick request: can procurement defaults be changed so `warm-demo` does not auto-confirm? We keep tripping on this.

lucy: +1, also adding a short runbook step: "for warm/demo requests, mark provisional until D-1". I'll open a tiny PR to procurement rules.

raj: Vendor replied: will flip to provisional in 25m after PO updated. I updated PO-10122 to provisional and removed tag.

ops-oncall: kernel backport finished @02:48 SGT. Running reconciler now.

nina: reconciler output: vendor_allocated=96, holds=[PO-10122(provisional)], active=96. Delta resolved.

lucy: Logged incident note and created a short alert: if vendor_allocated - active > 20 for > 10m, route to #eng-infra and notify procurement-bot.

nina: Thanks all — raj pls follow up with vendor to ensure no invoice auto-pay and raj/lucy to update procurement playbook. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
